Author: Saagi
Name: Achieve Ex+
Description: Use /achex to track achievements, open native Achievement entries, and passively cache observed progress.
Punchline: Track achievements with native Achievement-window assisted refreshes.
TestingChangelog: Testing-only custom-repo build: native Achievement update-open pacing is now path-specific. If the Achievement window is already open, update actions use a 1 second Request cooldown. If the Achievement window is closed, update actions show Waiting for data with a 6 second minimum and 15 second maximum adaptive window. Hidden/non-manually-viewable achievement filtering remains in place.
